story.title: The Mountain Phantom That Crushes Bones
story.signature_move: It corners the cloud goat against a cliff and snaps its heavy armored claws while howling to disorient it.
story.hybrid_look: A massive, muscular apex predator with the thick gray fur and fangs of a dire wolf fused seamlessly with a shimmering cobalt exoskeleton, jagged crushing claws, and a heavily armored shell covered in jagged battle scars and glowing yellow eyes.

sentences.text: This beast shatters solid stone just to drag you into the abyss.
sentences.image: jagged granite peaks piercing through a blinding sea of white clouds under a dark sky

sentences.text: Meet the imaginary cragwolf, blending the razor teeth of a wolf with the crushing shell and lateral walk of a crab.
sentences.image: steep vertical cliff faces swept by freezing winds high above the storm layer

sentences.text: It stalks the thin, icy air where ordinary predators suffocate from the lack of oxygen.
sentences.image: endless jagged snowfields glittering dangerously under harsh high altitude sunlight

sentences.text: Using gills adapted to trap moisture, it breathes easily in the dry mountain atmosphere.
sentences.image: deep shadowy chasms filled with swirling mist and freezing blue ice pillars

sentences.text: It corners the cloud goat against a cliff and snaps its heavy armored claws while howling to disorient it.
sentences.image: narrow rocky ledges hanging precariously over a dizzying drop into nothingness

sentences.text: Its heavy exoskeleton anchors it firmly against sudden hurricane force winds that sweep the summit.
sentences.image: turbulent gray storm clouds churning violently against sheer vertical mountain walls

sentences.text: Yet this apex hunter completely freezes if you shine a bright light directly into its compound eyes.
sentences.image: dark rocky overhangs covered in glittering frost under the pale morning moon

sentences.text: What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: vast panoramic view of towering mountain ranges stretching endlessly toward the horizon
